commands.name: bus
commands.description: Session bus: status, peers and recent messages.
commands.output: Session bus: off. Run /bus-new to create a channel, or /bus-join <secret>.

commands.name: bus-new
commands.description: Session bus: create a new channel secret and join it.
commands.output:
Joined the bus as "local-app-prev" via https://ntfy.sh.

Channel secret (share it only with your own sessions):
75O1wMGZx042ScpW3maOajHtvjmbAc69

Local sessions: /bus-join <secret>. Cloud sessions: set SESSION_BUS_SECRET=<secret> in the cloud environment.

commands.name: bus-join
commands.description: Session bus: join a channel by its secret.

commands.name: bus-leave
commands.description: Session bus: forget the stored secret and leave.
commands.output: Left the bus and forgot the stored secret (SESSION_BUS_SECRET, if set, still applies next session).

commands.name: bus-name
commands.description: Session bus: set this session's name on the bus.
commands.output: A name is 1-40 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -

commands.name: bus-set
commands.description: Session bus: set a session's model and/or effort ('me' for this one, '-' to skip, 'default' to reset).

tools.name: bus_send
tools.description: Send a message to another Claude Code session (cloud or local) on the session bus. `to` is a peer name or id from bus_peers, or "*" for every session. Messages wake the receiver.

tools.name: bus_peers
tools.description: List the Claude Code sessions currently on the session bus, and this session's own name.

tools.name: bus_control
tools.description: Change the model and/or reasoning effort another session on the bus uses for its next requests. model: opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, a claude-* id, or "default" to hand it back; effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, or "default". Only do this when the user asked for it.

tools.name: bus_inbox
tools.description: Read the most recent messages other sessions sent to this one over the session bus.
